confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee estimates are grounded in current Vancouver cost-of-living aggregates; beer values vary by source. Cocktail uses a current downtown-club typical price, and wine by the glass uses the midpoint of a local wine-bar range. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal and neighborhood variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Vancouver's own current restaurant-price aggregates are the main basis; accommodation reflects a high-cost, tourism-heavy Pacific Northwest city.
